title: Bulk reads and skip count the characters that survive a filter
summary: A positive-length read skipped a fully discarded chunk and returned the surviving character. Extra leading discarded characters did not change the value following a skip.

change.description: The reader now continues past an entirely discarded chunk during a positive-length read. Skipping traverses the filtered stream so discarded characters do not consume the caller’s skip budget.

notes: Deleting x first leaves ab in every case. Skipping its first retained character can only leave b.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 2.22.0 matched the parent on all three histories.
